svg.text: Where the cycles go: build (b) vs build (c), by layer type, to scale
single-cycle core; “other” = padding setup, average pool, fully connected and arg-max
Pointwise: 8.72 M → 1.55 M (5.6× fewer). DOT4.S8 fits it: four input channels per word.
Depthwise: 1.59 M → 1.41 M (1.1×). Each word holds four different channels, so it stays on mul, and is now 42% of build (c).
